findings: Original SNL24 assigns identification15 on Plate22 to the M318 assembly; HB122callout15 independently names M318. The leader points to the inner bolt near y355, not the outer case-joint bolt near y200. Prior59.257mm outward discrepancy and proposed carrier-rim enlargement are withdrawn.

The upper inner source feature is a ring bolt and the lower feature is a planet pin. The earlier two-planet/composite-section interpretation is withdrawn for this pair. A native plane through planet0 and opposite ring bolt1 gives the shown comparison without changing their saved placements.

The revised native section follows the chosen bolt radius148.771428571mm, head-seatx906 and nut-seatx842 under the unchanged conditional scale. Agreement with these input picks is construction evidence, not independent historical dimensional validation.

The carrier-side oblique view exposes three large pin-nut recesses and three smaller ring-bolt nut recesses. The outer dish silhouette and protected central hub are retained. The earlier pin-ring/front view and this carrier-face view use opposite axial viewing directions to reveal different retained details.

The bolt-axis cutaway shows the shorter M318 shank, recessed head shoulder, continuous axial access counterbore and separate nut/cotter. The geometry check confirms sampled bolt extraction with nut/cotter absent. Boss radii, pocket contours,2mm nominal counterbore wall and7mm nominal nut-recess wall are inferred; tool access and structural performance remain unqualified.

The retained pin-axis section preserves the hollow pin, bronze bush and steel sleeve. Printed7/8in bolt size is retained despite differences from the illustrated shank profile. Planet-center11.521mm and earlier gear-outline/axial station discrepancies remain documented.

Case-joint bolts remain absent and must be modeled as their own fastening family. Small planetary gears, bevel/input assemblies, brakes, controls, complete mounting/lubrication and full-tank integration remain unfinished.
